body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Psychic Damage. The target suffers -1 Composure against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, suppress 1 point of its next ordinary numerical attack bonus until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Assault
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, gain +1 Composure against the target until the start of your next turn; no existing injury on either creature changes.
